description: Assign a finding to an organisation member, or clear its assignment. Requires write permission. Assignment can notify the assignee by email and Slack and synchronise connected issue trackers.

assigneeUserId.description: Organisation member user ID, or null to clear assignment.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

name: assign_finding
title: Assign a finding
